description: Finds every pin of this library in a consumer: `?ref=<tag>` on a taskfiles.git include, in any Taskfile, with no annotation above it. Every pin shares one depName, so they move in one pull request.
A moved pin needs its lock refreshed before the Taskfile loads again: extend renovate/tasklib-lock.json as well, or run `task --yes --offline=false --download tasklib:lock` on the branch.
The file pattern is the one tasklib/Taskfile.yaml names _TL_NAME_RE; tests/tasklib.test.sh holds the two equal.
